title: Oracle Synthesis Based on X-Map Decision Diagrams
summary: Quantum oracles act as reversible black-box operators that encode classical Boolean functions into quantum states, enabling efficient function evaluation in quantum superposition. The resource efficiency of oracle implementation is critical to the performance of numerous quantum algorithms. Most state-of-the-art oracle synthesis approaches rely on compact Boolean function representations such as exclusive-sum-of-products (ESOP), yet still suffer from excessive $T$-count and $CX$-count for large-scale functions.
